h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Gwalior

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Gwalior

c: Gwalior has a long tradition of boarding schools, and school campuses here are among the biggest users of outdoor fitness equipment. A boarding student has the evening free and no indoor gym to go to. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to schools, colleges, cantonment areas, housing colonies and municipal parks in Gwalior, made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 930 km away.

Gwalior has fierce summers and cold winter mornings, so a school gym needs to stand outdoors through both without care beyond the basics. Our frames are galvanised pipe and our seats are roto-moulded plastic. We deliver by road and install through our own team or a dealer in central India, grouted or self-standing. Tell us the age group of the students, the size of the ground and how many will use it after school. We will send a layout drawing and a quote for the school management to approve.

items.q: Is outdoor gym equipment safe for school students?
items.a: Our Fun Fitness machines use the person's own body weight, with no loose weights. We mark the clear space around each machine on the layout drawing, and students should use them with a teacher nearby.

items.q: Can the equipment stay outside through a Gwalior winter and summer?
items.a: Yes. The galvanised frames and roto-moulded seats are made for outdoor use in heat and cold. Basic care, such as checking bolts and moving parts, keeps them working well.

items.q: Do you supply outdoor gyms to cantonment and colony parks?
items.a: Yes. We supply schools, colleges, colonies and public parks. Send us the site size and photos, and we will suggest a set of machines with a layout drawing.
